# Copy and runtime boundaries

- Strategy and product truth: `docs/ssot/` and owner DEC files.
- Evidence/public facts: `research/raimov-profile/` and `RAIMOV_PUBLIC_PROFILE.md`.
- Approved public/professional wording: `docs/copy/raimov/`.
- Runtime implementation: `site-raimovdental/`.
- Release evidence: `docs/audits/raimov/` and `docs/raimov/release/`.

Copy never becomes evidence; runtime never becomes strategy authority. A documentation decision does not authorise a public route or deploy. Patient and professional forms, consent and analytics remain separate.
